A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Senator''' of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] once demanded harsher penalties for vagrancy within [[The Works/Legends|the Works]], a major industrial complex on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that was home to many of Coruscant's homeless. In reprisal, the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] found his water supply mysteriously cut off forty [[Time/Legends|times]] in a single month.
